sources.title: Customizing Neural Machine Translation Models with NVIDIA NeMo, Part 1
sources.snippet: The development of attention-based transformer models has significantly impacted neural machine translation (NMT) tasks, but common issues like mistranslation and lack of semantic accuracy still exist due to mismatched training data and use cases. sources.title: On Instruction-Finetuning Neural Machine Translation Models
sources.snippet: In this work, we introduce instruction finetuning for Neural Machine Translation (NMT) models, which distills instruction following capabilities from Large Language Models (LLMs) into orders-of-magnitude smaller NMT models. Our instruction-finetuning recipe for NMT models enables customization of translations for a limited but disparate set of translation-specific tasks. We show that NMT ...

sources.title: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) | Google Cloud Documentation
sources.snippet: Neural Machine Translation (NMT) model Google's standard Neural Machine Translation (NMT) has evolved from the neural network translation system that Google introduced in November 2016, with many improvements. It can translate to and from many languages in real time. Its model ID is general/nmt.
